summary: Recent discussions in the Iceberg community include proposals for enhancing durability with checksums, implementing fine-grained access policies, and improving the iceberg-kafka-connect connector. Additionally, updates on the integration with Spark and the upcoming Iceberg 1.11.0 release were highlighted.
highlights: Integration work and discussions related to Spark 4.1 and 4.2 features
Proposal for adding checksums in Iceberg libraries
Fine-grained access policies in loadTable response
